notice.title: Help us better understand collaboration in founder teams.
notice.body:
If you like, we may use selected answers from your questionnaires and information on how you fill them in (such as time taken) in pseudonymised form for scientific research on collaboration in founding teams — also outside Made2Found, for example in a publication. Free text, names and email addresses are not included.

Taking part is voluntary. You can use Made2Found just the same if you do not, and you can stop at any time in your account.

settings.title: Research participation
settings.description: You decide freely whether selected answers from your questionnaires and information on how you fill them in may be used in pseudonymised form for scientific research — including in publications. Free text is not included.
settings.withdrawal:
After you stop, we store no new research data and delete what can still be attributed to you.

What cannot be undone: analyses in which your answers have already been combined with those of others. Your share cannot be subtracted back out of a frequency across a hundred people, and what has been published stays published.
